headline: Gale warnings: stay put this weekend
dateline: 7pm CDT Fri Oct 16 – early Sun Oct 18
what: Bays from Mississippi Sound to Choctawhatchee: north 20–30 kt, gusts to 35. Coastal waters: gusts to 40 kt, seas 5–8 ft. Louisiana waters and Lake Pontchartrain: gusts to 45 kt.
why: One week after Isaias, damaged docks and boats waiting on repairs are especially exposed to a hard north blow.
todo: Postpone passages until Sunday at the earliest. Double your lines, add chafe gear, and check on your boat before tonight.
